# s223 — Show open items that exist only in a sibling worktree

An open item filed in a linked worktree and never committed is invisible on the other checkout. `list` and `status` stay quiet, and `check` stays green, because an id that exists only in the sibling is not a collision.

**Findings:** roadmap review 2026-10-05: s192-s201 were open only in a sibling worktree and main's list stayed empty; first filed as s203 on the superseded feature/agents-feedback branch · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** failing `check` for a sibling-only id (`test_Check_IdOnlyInSibling_NoWarning` stays). Copying or importing the sibling's items. Renumbering. Reading other branches with `git show`. Statuses other than the open status.

## Why

`store._elsewhere_counts` returns false when this checkout has no item with that id, unless the sibling row is claimed or in-work (`src/slicer/store.py`). An unclaimed open item therefore never reaches `list`'s `in_work_elsewhere` map or `status`. s185 compares titles only when both indexes contain the id. `sibling_ids` already reads the sibling indexes. On 2026-10-05, s192 through s201 were open only in `.worktrees/agents-feedback` while `main`'s `list` omitted them and `next-id` was s203.

## Files

- `src/slicer/store.py` (the sibling-only open rows)
- `src/slicer/cli.py` (`list` and `status`)
- `docs/commands.md`, `docs/agents.md`
- `tests/test_sibling_ids.py`
- `CHANGELOG.md`

## Failing tests

1. `test_List_OpenOnlyInSibling_NamesIt`: the sibling adds an unclaimed item in the open status that this checkout does not have. `list` exits 0. Text names the id, the title, and the worktree name under an `Only in a sibling` heading. JSON has `only_in_sibling`, a list of `{id, title, worktree, status}` in worktree-path order, then id order. `check` still exits 0 with no collision warning.
2. `test_Status_OpenOnlyInSibling_NamesIt`: `status` exits 0 and prints the same id, title, and worktree. `next` is unchanged. JSON includes the same `only_in_sibling` list.
3. `test_List_KnownId_NotOnlyInSibling`: an id present in both checkouts is not in `only_in_sibling`, including when the sibling's status differs. A claimed or in-work sibling row stays in `in_work_elsewhere`.
4. `test_List_SiblingDoneOnly_IsNotListed`: a done item that exists only in the sibling is not in `only_in_sibling`.

## Implement

Report sibling items whose id is absent here, whose status is the sibling's open status, and which are neither claimed nor in-work. `list` and `status` gain `only_in_sibling`. Text prints `Only in a sibling` and one line per row, `ID  worktree  title`, or `Only in a sibling   none` when the list is empty and the command is already printing other sections. `status` prints the heading only when the list is non-empty, so a checkout with no such sibling stays as it is today.

Do not change `check`, `next`, or the `in_work_elsewhere` rules.

CHANGELOG under `[Unreleased]`, `### Fixed`.
